description: Detects load of AggregatorHost.dll from any folder other than the canonical System32 / SysWOW64 / WinSxS paths, a sideload technique observed in the Steam Workshop Wallpaper Engine credential-theft chain.

  product: windows

      - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'

description: Detects file writes by a Langflow Python worker (python/uvicorn whose ancestry contains 'langflow') into /tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm, %TEMP%, or %ProgramData% — consistent with the CVE-2026-48519 PoC's `touch /tmp/pwned` canary and real-world second-stage staging.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v5ff-9q35-q26f
  - https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/security/advisories/GHSA-vwmf-pq79-vjvx

  - attack.t1059.006

  category: file_event

  proc_python:
    Image|contains:
      - 'python'
      - 'uvicorn'
  proc_langflow:

  path_world_writable:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/tmp/'
      - '/var/tmp/'
      - '/dev/shm/'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'

  filter_extensions:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.sh'
      - '.py'

description: Detects access to Steam session-persistence files (loginusers.vdf, config.vdf, ssfn*) by any process other than the official Steam clients. The Kaspersky write-up describes AggregatorHost.dll, dropped by malicious Workshop wallpapers, hunting these files to hijack the active Steam session.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/dozens-of-malicious-wallpapers-found-on-steam-workshop/120186/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.t1539
  - attack.t1555
  - attack.credential_access
logsource:
  category: file_access
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\Steam\config\'
  selection_file:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\loginusers.vdf'
      - '\config.vdf'
    TargetFilename|contains: '\ssfn'
  filter_steam:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\steam.exe'
      - '\steamservice.exe'
      - '\steamwebhelper.exe'
      - '\steamerrorreporter.exe'
      - '\steamerrorreporter64.exe'
      - '\steam_bootstrap.exe'
  condition: selection_path and (1 of selection_file*) and not filter_steam
falsepositives:
  - Steam backup/cloud sync utilities
  - Antivirus on-access scanning (typically the scanner process is excluded by AV vendor)
level: high
2498.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem WHERE (Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Steam\\config\\%" OR Filesystem.file_name LIKE "ssfn%" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("loginusers.vdf","config.vdf")) AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("steam.exe","steamservice.exe","steamwebhelper.exe","steamerrorreporter.exe","steamerrorreporter64.exe") BY Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2498.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\Steam\\config\\loginusers.vdf OR *\\Steam\\config\\config.vdf OR *\\Steam\\config\\ssfn* OR *\\steam\\config\\loginusers.vdf OR *\\steam\\config\\config.vdf OR *\\steam\\config\\ssfn*) -@Image:(*\\steam.exe OR *\\Steam.exe OR *\\steamservice.exe OR *\\steamwebhelper.exe OR *\\steamerrorreporter.exe OR *\\steamerrorreporter64.exe OR *\\steam_bootstrap.exe)
2498.falcon:
(#event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo OR #event_simpleName=FileWritten) TargetFileName=/\\Steam\\config\\(loginusers\.vdf|config\.vdf|ssfn[^\\]*)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(steam|steamservice|steamwebhelper|steamerrorreporter|steamerrorreporter64|steam_bootstrap)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2499.sigma:
title: Network Callback to Malicious Steam Workshop Wallpaper C2
id: 7b3e6d12-5a8f-4c20-9d11-2c4e7b8a5f21
description: Detects outbound network communication to the C2 IPs (120.48.156.17, 202.144.192.29) and URL paths (/ey.php, /audit.php, /download2/Themes2.zip) published in Kaspersky's IoC bundle for the malicious Steam Workshop wallpaper campaign.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/dozens-of-malicious-wallpapers-found-on-steam-workshop/120186/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.command_and_control
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ip:
    DestinationIp:
      - '120.48.156.17'
      - '202.144.192.29'
  selection_url:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - '120.48.156.17'
      - '202.144.192.29'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Threat intel platforms or sandboxes detonating samples
level: critical
2499.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic WHERE (All_Traffic.dest IN ("120.48.156.17","202.144.192.29")) BY All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.url | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2499.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@DestinationIp:("120.48.156.17" OR "202.144.192.29") OR @DestinationHostname:("120.48.156.17" OR "202.144.192.29"))) OR (source:cloudtrail AND @sourceIPAddress:("120.48.156.17" OR "202.144.192.29")) OR (@network.destination.ip:("120.48.156.17" OR "202.144.192.29")) OR (@http.url:(*\/ey.php* OR *\/audit.php* OR *\/download2\/Themes2.zip*))
2499.falcon:
